svg.title: Hypertension treatment decision chart: treat once blood pressure is over the threshold for the patient's risk, start one drug or a low-dose two-drug pill depending on the distance from target, then build the cocktail in steps (RAAS inhibitor, a diuretic and a calcium channel blocker, then spironolactone, beta blocker or doxazosin), each class with when to choose it and when to avoid it

svg.text: Hypertension above the threshold for this patient's RISK: which drugs, in what order?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: START → TARGET (mmHg): HIGH risk systolic ≥ 130 → ≤ 120 · DIABETES ≥ 130/80 → < 130/80

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: healthy behaviours for everyone · ≤ 10 mmHg above target: ONE drug · > 10 mmHg: TWO drugs as a low-dose single pill

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: not at target: ADD a drug, don't double one (half dose gives 80% of the effect)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: pair a renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) INHIBITOR with a STIMULATOR
